aboutGame.title: What is Sminofu iTekisi?
paragraphs: Sminofu iTekisi is the 2026 Maskandi album by South African artist Sminofu, released on October 16, 2026 through Sminofu / EMPIRE. The 17-track project runs about one hour and six minutes, with twelve solo songs and five collaborations featuring four guest artists.

The title is isiZulu for taxi, and the record uses that everyday setting as a frame for movement, hustle, conversation, and shared experience. Its Maskandi foundation centers fingerpicked guitar and storytelling, while the sequencing moves from a short intro and title track into a feature-heavy second half before closing on eMachobeni.

items.question: What is Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: Sminofu iTekisi is the 2026 Maskandi album by South African artist Sminofu. It was released on October 16, 2026 through Sminofu / EMPIRE and contains 17 tracks across about one hour and six minutes.

items.question: How many songs are on Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: There are 17 songs, including the 1:28 intro Benilindele Bani, the 4:06 title track iTekisi, and the 3:43 closer eMachobeni. Twelve tracks are solo and five include guest artists.

items.question: Who features on Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: Londeka Shangase, Ojakalasi, Njabulo Langa, and Zanefa Ngidi appear across five tracks. Shangase is the only guest with two appearances, on Ngithunjiwe and Ngo December.

items.question: What does the title Sminofu iTekisi mean?
items.answer: Itekisi is isiZulu for taxi. The album uses that everyday setting to frame movement, hustle, conversation, reputation, and shared experience.
